title: Covenant of Mercy
description: This mezmur is a heartfelt devotion to the Holy Virgin Mary under the title of Kidane Mehret (Covenant of Mercy). It expresses patience, suffering, and ultimate consolation through her intercession. The chant reflects the believer’s reliance on the Mother of God during hardship, emphasizing her compassion, protection, and healing power. It highlights themes of endurance, faith, and the peace and comfort found through her prayers, leading to restoration and spiritual strength.
